exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Must / Have to".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
～なければ ならない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～なければ ならない matches "Must / Have to".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～なければ ならない.
exercises.explanation: Expresses obligation; used to say someone must or has to do something.

exercises.question: Choose the correct meaning for: ～なければ ならない.

options.text: Must / Have to
Such as A and B
Not as much/less than
Not as...as

exercises.correctFeedback: Correct! ～なければ ならない means "Must / Have to".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct meaning is "Must / Have to".
